_about: Presets for the Remotion Vertical template, picked with `--format NAME` (ss render / ss batch). Any flag overrides a preset value. Codes match the naming convention SS_DATE_FORMAT_CONCEPT_HOOK_Vnn_MASTER. Keep end-card text truthful: the game is not published yet (docs/game-truth.md).
